title: ALMA Observations of the Very Young Class 0 Protostellar System HH211-mms: A 30 au Dusty Disk with a Disk Wind Traced by SO?
question: How early and how small a disk can form around a very young Class 0 protostar (HH 211-mms), and does a rotating SO outflow trace a disk wind?

data.sensitivity: continuum 0.11 and 0.154 mJy/beam; SO ~1.6 mJy/beam at 3 km/s

what.value: VLA 36.9 GHz disk flux density ~0.855 mJy

evidence.quote: with a flux density of $\sim$ 0.855 mJy (cite: Tobin2016; Segura-Cox2016)

what.value: Free-free-corrected dust flux ~0.57 mJy at ~33 GHz

evidence.quote: the flux density of the dust emission corrected for the free-free emission is $\sim$ 0.57 mJy at $\sim$ 33 GHz

what.value: Systemic velocity from H13CO+ and jet PA/inclination

evidence.quote: the jet has a position angle of 116.5$^\circ$ and an inclination angle of $\lesssim$ 6$^\circ$ to the plane of the sky

evidence.loc: 3.2 Disk Atmosphere and Rotating Outflow in SO
evidence.quote: Assuming an SO abundance of $2\times10^{-6}$ as found in the jet (cite: Lee2010)

what.value: Disk radius vs protostellar mass compilation

evidence.quote: The growth of Keplerian disk radius from Class 0 to I phase has been studied by (cite: Yen2017).

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and SO
recipe.method: CASA calibration; continuum from line-free channels at robust 0.5/-0.5; SO at robust 2, binned to 3 km/s

recipe.goal: Measure disk geometry and flux in continuum
recipe.method: Two-dimensional Gaussian fit and intensity cut along the major axis
Spectral index between 33 GHz dust flux and 350 GHz flux; optically thin mass formula M = D^2 F / (B(T) kappa)
assumptions: Two mass opacities (Beckwith 1990; Ossenkopf & Henning 1994 via Tychoniec 2018); optically thin so lower limit

recipe.goal: SO kinematics: protostellar mass and angular momentum
recipe.method: Channel maps and PV diagrams across the jet axis; Keplerian curves outline the PV outer boundaries; linear/elliptical PV structures give specific angular momentum

recipe.goal: SO column density and mass of atmosphere plus outflow
recipe.method: Optically thin LTE column density from mean intensity, converted to H2 using SO abundance

recipe.goal: Compare disk radius with protostellar mass growth models
recipe.method: Add HH 211-mms to Yen et al. 2017 plot and compare to R_d ∝ M^3 (Terebey 1984) and R_d ∝ M (Basu 1998) tracks
